SkinVision app version 6.0; commercially launched, clinically validated, regulated, and widely used consumer-facing medical mobile application.
Initially launched in 2011. As of October 2018, the app had reached version 5. Current version is SkinVision app 6.0.

SkinVision is an innovative mobile application designed to help people detect skin cancer early. By combining a clinically validated artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm with the expertise of leading dermatologists, our app analyzes photos of moles and skin spots to assess the risk of skin cancer with high accuracy. SkinVision achieves a sensitivity of over 90% in detecting skin cancer, accurately identifying more than 9 out of 10 cases. Trusted by over 3 million users worldwide, SkinVision has performed more than 5 million skin checks to date. We are proud to be a partner in proactive skin health, offering accessible, reliable, and effective solutions to overcome barriers to early detection.

Analyze photos of skin lesions taken with a smartphone and classify them with a risk indication (low/medium/high) and track over a duration of time. Meant to empower the individual to self monitor skin lesions and decide when a medical followup should be considered- should not be used as a diagnostic tool (“you have melanoma”).
Empowers patients to practice preventative self monitoring.
The SkinVision Service is not intended for use on persons under the age of 18 years old. The SkinVision Service does not diagnose skin cancer, does not provide any other diagnosis.

The model fits into direct-to-patient preventative care. Users can take photos of their skin at home, get instant feedback, then share results with their physician. The app also makes tracking lesions over time with digital monitoring easier. The app does not replace clinical dermatologist diagnoses, but physicians can use the information as supplementary material.
